<h1 id="tool-系统分析">Tool 系统分析</h1>
<p>请关注微信公众号：<a href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/1POBRXDahByqmKNZ5Y5MZA" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">阿呆-bot</a></p>
<h2 id="概述">概述</h2>
<p>本文档分析 Spring AI Alibaba Agent Framework 中的 Tool（工具）系统，包括工具的定义、注册、调用流程、扩展机制以及 AgentTool 的实现。</p>
<h2 id="入口类说明">入口类说明</h2>
<h3 id="toolcallback---工具回调接口">ToolCallback - 工具回调接口</h3>
<p><code>ToolCallback</code> 是 Spring AI 提供的工具接口，定义了工具的基本能力。</p>
<p><strong>核心职责</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>定义工具名称和描述</li>
<li>定义工具输入输出 Schema</li>
<li>执行工具调用</li>
<li>返回工具结果</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="agenttool---agent-作为工具">AgentTool - Agent 作为工具</h3>
<p><code>AgentTool</code> 将 ReactAgent 封装为工具，使 Agent 可以作为工具被其他 Agent 调用。</p>
<p><strong>核心职责</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>将 Agent 转换为 ToolCallback</li>
<li>执行 Agent 调用</li>
<li>返回 Agent 响应</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-37:103:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/AgentTool.java">public class AgentTool implements BiFunction&lt;String, ToolContext, AssistantMessage&gt; {

	private final ReactAgent agent;

	public AgentTool(ReactAgent agent) {
		this.agent = agent;
	}

	@Override
	public AssistantMessage apply(String input, ToolContext toolContext) {
		OverAllState state = (OverAllState) toolContext.getContext().get("state");
		try {
			// Copy state to avoid affecting the original state.
			// The agent that calls this tool should only be aware of the ToolCallChoice and ToolResponse.
			OverAllState newState = agent.getAndCompileGraph().cloneState(state.data());
			
			// Build the messages list to add
			// Add instruction first if present, then the user input
			// Note: We must add all messages at once because cloneState doesn't copy keyStrategies,
			// so multiple updateState calls would overwrite instead of append
			java.util.List&lt;Message&gt; messagesToAdd = new java.util.ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
			if (StringUtils.hasLength(agent.instruction())) {
				messagesToAdd.add(new AgentInstructionMessage(agent.instruction()));
			}
			messagesToAdd.add(new UserMessage(input));
			
			Map&lt;String, Object&gt; inputs = newState.updateState(Map.of("messages", messagesToAdd));

			Optional&lt;OverAllState&gt; resultState = agent.getAndCompileGraph().invoke(inputs);

			Optional&lt;List&gt; messages = resultState.flatMap(overAllState -&gt; overAllState.value("messages", List.class));
			if (messages.isPresent()) {
				@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
				List&lt;Message&gt; messageList = (List&lt;Message&gt;) messages.get();
				// Use messageList
				AssistantMessage assistantMessage = (AssistantMessage)messageList.get(messageList.size() - 1);
				return assistantMessage;
			}
		}
		catch (Exception e) {
			throw new RuntimeException(e);
		}
		throw new RuntimeException("Failed to execute agent tool or failed to get agent tool result");
	}

	public static ToolCallback getFunctionToolCallback(ReactAgent agent) {
		// convert agent inputType to json schema
		String inputSchema = StringUtils.hasLength(agent.getInputSchema())
				? agent.getInputSchema()
				: (agent.getInputType() != null )
					? JsonSchemaGenerator.generateForType(agent.getInputType())
					: null;

		return FunctionToolCallback.builder(agent.name(), AgentTool.create(agent))
			.description(agent.description())
			.inputType(String.class) // the inputType for ToolCallback is always String
			.inputSchema(inputSchema)
			.toolCallResultConverter(CONVERTER)
			.build();
	}

}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键特性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>状态隔离</strong>：通过 <code>cloneState()</code> 创建独立状态，避免影响调用 Agent 的状态</li>
<li><strong>指令传递</strong>：支持传递 Agent 指令</li>
<li><strong>Schema 生成</strong>：自动生成工具输入 Schema</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="agenttoolnode---工具执行节点">AgentToolNode - 工具执行节点</h3>
<p><code>AgentToolNode</code> 是执行工具调用的 Graph 节点。</p>
<p><strong>核心职责</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>解析工具调用请求</li>
<li>执行工具调用</li>
<li>处理工具响应</li>
<li>支持工具拦截器</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-43:132:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/node/AgentToolNode.java">public class AgentToolNode implements NodeActionWithConfig {

	private List&lt;ToolCallback&gt; toolCallbacks = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

	private List&lt;ToolInterceptor&gt; toolInterceptors = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

	private ToolCallbackResolver toolCallbackResolver;

	@Override
	public Map&lt;String, Object&gt; apply(OverAllState state, RunnableConfig config) throws Exception {
		List&lt;Message&gt; messages = (List&lt;Message&gt;) state.value("messages").orElseThrow();
		Message lastMessage = messages.get(messages.size() - 1);

		Map&lt;String, Object&gt; updatedState = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
		Map&lt;String, Object&gt; extraStateFromToolCall = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
		if (lastMessage instanceof AssistantMessage assistantMessage) {
			// execute the tool function
			List&lt;ToolResponseMessage.ToolResponse&gt; toolResponses = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
			for (AssistantMessage.ToolCall toolCall : assistantMessage.getToolCalls()) {
				// Execute tool call with interceptor chain
				ToolCallResponse response = executeToolCallWithInterceptors(toolCall, state, config, extraStateFromToolCall);
				toolResponses.add(response.toToolResponse());
			}

			ToolResponseMessage toolResponseMessage = new ToolResponseMessage(toolResponses, Map.of());
			updatedState.put("messages", toolResponseMessage);
		} else if (lastMessage instanceof ToolResponseMessage toolResponseMessage) {
			// Handle incremental tool execution
			// ...
		} else {
			throw new IllegalStateException("Last message is not an AssistantMessage or ToolResponseMessage");
		}

		// Merge extra state from tool calls
		updatedState.putAll(extraStateFromToolCall);
		return updatedState;
	}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="agentllmnode---llm-节点">AgentLlmNode - LLM 节点</h3>
<p><code>AgentLlmNode</code> 负责调用 LLM，并将工具信息传递给模型。</p>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-48:138:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/node/AgentLlmNode.java">public class AgentLlmNode implements NodeActionWithConfig {

	private List&lt;ToolCallback&gt; toolCallbacks = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

	private List&lt;ModelInterceptor&gt; modelInterceptors = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

	private ChatClient chatClient;

	@Override
	public Map&lt;String, Object&gt; apply(OverAllState state, RunnableConfig config) throws Exception {
		// add streaming support
		boolean stream = config.metadata("_stream_", new TypeRef&lt;Boolean&gt;(){}).orElse(true);
		if (stream) {
			@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
			List&lt;Message&gt; messages = (List&lt;Message&gt;) state.value("messages").get();
			augmentUserMessage(messages, outputSchema);
			renderTemplatedUserMessage(messages, state.data());

			// Create ModelRequest
			ModelRequest modelRequest = ModelRequest.builder()
					.messages(messages)
					.options(toolCallingChatOptions)
					.context(config.metadata().orElse(new HashMap&lt;&gt;()))
					.build();

			// Create base handler that actually calls the model with streaming
			ModelCallHandler baseHandler = request -&gt; {
				try {
					Flux&lt;ChatResponse&gt; chatResponseFlux = buildChatClientRequestSpec(request).stream().chatResponse();
					return ModelResponse.of(chatResponseFlux);
				} catch (Exception e) {
					return ModelResponse.of(new AssistantMessage("Exception: " + e.getMessage()));
				}
			};

			// Chain interceptors if any
			ModelCallHandler chainedHandler = InterceptorChain.chainModelInterceptors(
					modelInterceptors, baseHandler);

			// Execute the chained handler
			ModelResponse modelResponse = chainedHandler.call(modelRequest);
			return Map.of(StringUtils.hasLength(this.outputKey) ? this.outputKey : "messages", modelResponse.getMessage());
		} else {
			// Non-streaming mode
			// ...
		}
	}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="工具注册机制">工具注册机制</h2>
<h3 id="工具注册流程">工具注册流程</h3>
<p>工具通过以下方式注册：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>直接注册</strong>：通过 <code>ReactAgent.Builder.tools()</code> 方法注册</li>
<li><strong>Interceptor 工具</strong>：通过 <code>ModelInterceptor.getTools()</code> 方法提供</li>
<li><strong>工具解析器</strong>：通过 <code>ToolCallbackResolver</code> 动态解析</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-99:136:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/DefaultBuilder.java">// Extract regular tools from user-provided tools
		if (CollectionUtils.isNotEmpty(tools)) {
			regularTools.addAll(tools);
		}

		// Extract interceptor tools
		List&lt;ToolCallback&gt; interceptorTools = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
		if (CollectionUtils.isNotEmpty(modelInterceptors)) {
			interceptorTools = modelInterceptors.stream()
				.flatMap(interceptor -&gt; interceptor.getTools().stream())
				.collect(Collectors.toList());
		}

		// Combine all tools: regularTools + regularTools
		List&lt;ToolCallback&gt; allTools = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
		allTools.addAll(interceptorTools);
		allTools.addAll(regularTools);

		// Set combined tools to LLM node
		if (CollectionUtils.isNotEmpty(allTools)) {
			llmNodeBuilder.toolCallbacks(allTools);
		}

		AgentLlmNode llmNode = llmNodeBuilder.build();

		// Setup tool node with all available tools
		AgentToolNode toolNode = null;
		if (resolver != null) {
			toolNode = AgentToolNode.builder().toolCallbackResolver(resolver).build();
		}
		else if (CollectionUtils.isNotEmpty(allTools)) {
			toolNode = AgentToolNode.builder().toolCallbacks(allTools).build();
		}
		else {
			toolNode = AgentToolNode.builder().build();
		}

		return new ReactAgent(llmNode, toolNode, buildConfig(), this);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="工具调用流程">工具调用流程</h2>
<h3 id="工具调用步骤">工具调用步骤</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>LLM 生成工具调用</strong>：AgentLlmNode 调用 LLM，LLM 返回包含工具调用的 AssistantMessage</li>
<li><strong>工具调用解析</strong>：AgentToolNode 解析 AssistantMessage 中的工具调用</li>
<li><strong>工具执行</strong>：通过工具拦截器链执行工具调用</li>
<li><strong>响应生成</strong>：将工具执行结果封装为 ToolResponseMessage</li>
<li><strong>状态更新</strong>：更新状态中的消息列表</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>关键代码</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-137:165:spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/main/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/node/AgentToolNode.java">/**
	 * Execute a tool call with interceptor chain support.
	 */
	private ToolCallResponse executeToolCallWithInterceptors(
			AssistantMessage.ToolCall toolCall,
			OverAllState state,
			RunnableConfig config,
			Map&lt;String, Object&gt; extraStateFromToolCall) {

		// Create ToolCallRequest
		ToolCallRequest request = ToolCallRequest.builder()
				.toolCall(toolCall)
				.context(config.metadata().orElse(new HashMap&lt;&gt;()))
				.build();

		// Create base handler that actually executes the tool
		ToolCallHandler baseHandler = req -&gt; {
			ToolCallback toolCallback = resolve(req.getToolName());
			String result = toolCallback.call(
				req.getArguments(),
				new ToolContext(Map.of("state", state, "config", config, "extraState", extraStateFromToolCall))
			);
			return ToolCallResponse.of(req.getToolCallId(), req.getToolName(), result);
		};

		// Chain interceptors if any
		ToolCallHandler chainedHandler = InterceptorChain.chainToolInterceptors(
			toolInterceptors, baseHandler);

		// Execute the chained handler
		return chainedHandler.call(request);
	}

	private ToolCallback resolve(String toolName) {
		return toolCallbacks.stream()
			.filter(callback -&gt; callback.getToolDefinition().name().equals(toolName))
			.findFirst()
			.orElseGet(() -&gt; toolCallbackResolver.resolve(toolName));
	}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="工具扩展机制">工具扩展机制</h2>
<h3 id="自定义工具实现">自定义工具实现</h3>
<p>开发者可以通过以下方式扩展工具：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>实现 ToolCallback 接口</strong>：创建自定义工具</li>
<li><strong>使用 FunctionToolCallback</strong>：将函数转换为工具</li>
<li><strong>AgentTool</strong>：将 Agent 转换为工具</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="工具类型">工具类型</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>函数工具</strong>：通过 <code>FunctionToolCallback</code> 将 Java 函数转换为工具</li>
<li><strong>Agent 工具</strong>：通过 <code>AgentTool</code> 将 Agent 转换为工具</li>
<li><strong>Interceptor 工具</strong>：通过 <code>ModelInterceptor.getTools()</code> 提供工具</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="关键类关系">关键类关系</h2>
<p>以下 PlantUML 类图展示了 Tool 系统的类关系：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/15798/202511/15798-20251118195432516-300069203.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="关键流程">关键流程</h2>
<p>以下 PlantUML 时序图展示了工具调用的完整流程：<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/15798/202511/15798-20251118195433743-1381065469.png" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="实现关键点说明">实现关键点说明</h2>
<h3 id="1-工具注册机制">1. 工具注册机制</h3>
<p>工具通过多种方式注册：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>直接注册</strong>：通过 Builder 的 <code>tools()</code> 方法</li>
<li><strong>Interceptor 工具</strong>：通过 <code>ModelInterceptor.getTools()</code></li>
<li><strong>动态解析</strong>：通过 <code>ToolCallbackResolver</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-工具调用流程">2. 工具调用流程</h3>
<p>工具调用经过以下步骤：</p>
<ol>
<li>LLM 生成工具调用请求</li>
<li>AgentToolNode 解析工具调用</li>
<li>通过拦截器链执行工具</li>
<li>生成工具响应</li>
<li>更新状态</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="3-拦截器支持">3. 拦截器支持</h3>
<p>工具调用支持拦截器：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ToolInterceptor</code> 可以拦截工具调用</li>
<li>支持请求修改和响应处理</li>
<li>支持重试、错误处理等功能</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="4-agent-作为工具">4. Agent 作为工具</h3>
<p>Agent 可以作为工具被调用：</p>
<ul>
<li>通过 <code>AgentTool</code> 封装</li>
<li>状态隔离，不影响调用 Agent</li>
<li>支持指令传递</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="5-工具解析器">5. 工具解析器</h3>
<p>支持动态工具解析：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>ToolCallbackResolver</code> 接口</li>
<li>可以按需加载工具</li>
<li>支持工具发现机制</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="6-状态管理">6. 状态管理</h3>
<p>工具调用可以更新状态：</p>
<ul>
<li>通过 <code>extraStateFromToolCall</code> 传递额外状态</li>
<li>工具响应添加到消息列表</li>
<li>支持状态合并</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="工具扩展示例">工具扩展示例</h2>
<h3 id="创建自定义工具">创建自定义工具</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// 1. 使用 FunctionToolCallback
FunctionToolCallback tool = FunctionToolCallback.builder("myTool", (input, context) -&gt; {
    // 工具逻辑
    return "result";
})
.description("My custom tool")
.build();

// 2. 实现 ToolCallback 接口
public class MyTool implements ToolCallback {
    @Override
    public String call(String arguments, ToolContext context) {
        // 工具逻辑
        return "result";
    }
    
    @Override
    public ToolDefinition getToolDefinition() {
        return ToolDefinition.builder()
            .name("myTool")
            .description("My custom tool")
            .build();
    }
}

// 3. 将 Agent 转换为工具
ReactAgent subAgent = ReactAgent.builder()
    .name("subAgent")
    .description("Sub agent")
    .model(model)
    .build();

ToolCallback agentTool = AgentTool.getFunctionToolCallback(subAgent);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="总结说明">总结说明</h2>
<h3 id="核心设计理念">核心设计理念</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>统一接口</strong>：所有工具实现 <code>ToolCallback</code> 接口</li>
<li><strong>灵活注册</strong>：支持多种工具注册方式</li>
<li><strong>拦截器支持</strong>：工具调用支持拦截器链</li>
<li><strong>Agent 工具化</strong>：Agent 可以作为工具被调用</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="关键优势">关键优势</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>灵活性</strong>：支持多种工具类型和注册方式</li>
<li><strong>可扩展性</strong>：易于添加新的工具实现</li>
<li><strong>可组合性</strong>：Agent 可以作为工具，实现 Agent 嵌套</li>
<li><strong>拦截器支持</strong>：支持工具调用的拦截和修改</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="解决的问题">解决的问题</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>工具集成</strong>：统一工具接口，简化工具集成</li>
<li><strong>Agent 嵌套</strong>：通过 AgentTool 实现 Agent 嵌套调用</li>
<li><strong>动态工具</strong>：通过 ToolCallbackResolver 支持动态工具加载</li>
<li><strong>工具拦截</strong>：通过拦截器支持工具调用的增强</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="使用场景">使用场景</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>函数工具</strong>：将业务函数封装为工具</li>
<li><strong>Agent 工具</strong>：将 Agent 封装为工具，实现多 Agent 协作</li>
<li><strong>Interceptor 工具</strong>：通过拦截器提供内置工具</li>
<li><strong>动态工具</strong>：通过解析器动态加载工具</li>
</ul>
<p>Tool 系统为 Agent Framework 提供了强大的工具能力，使开发者能够灵活地扩展 Agent 的功能，实现复杂的业务需求。</p>

</div>
